select_where: SELECT title, rating, price_inr FROM books WHERE rating >= 4
order_by_limit: SELECT title, price_inr FROM books ORDER BY price_inr DESC LIMIT 5
between: SELECT title, price_inr FROM books WHERE price_inr BETWEEN 500 AND 1500
join_top_rated_per_category: SELECT category_name, title, rating, price_inr FROM (SELECT c.category_name AS category_name, b.title AS title, b.rating AS rating, b.price_inr AS price_inr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY b.rating DESC, b.price_inr ASC) AS rank FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id) WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY category_name, rank
